player_intent: A player can choose a live server using accurate capacity, mode, map, tournament stage, and free-arena information.
acceptance_rule: Dedicated-server registration and every heartbeat publish sanitized current_players, mode_key, map_key, session_stage, and free_arenas values derived from the canonical authoritative session; a clean close request stops heartbeats, marks the listing offline, then quits.

nodes.role: Publishes one bounded snapshot of canonical server presence at the existing heartbeat interval.

must_not_change: tournament bracket and arena assignment authority
server shot, damage, ammunition, and ballistics authority
camera, movement, animation, and weapon presentation
client server-directory selection and user interface

system_delta.reason: Merge bounded live presence into the existing service-role heartbeat. Keep the canonical session as the facts provider and keep SocomServerBackend as the only database writer.

current.system: Static zero-player registration with health-only heartbeats

candidate.system: Canonical-session presence provider with one sanitized registration and heartbeat payload

visual_check: Run a dedicated server, admit and disconnect players, and confirm its match_servers row changes current_players while mode_key, map_key, session_stage, and free_arenas match the active canonical tournament state; close it normally and confirm the row becomes offline without waiting for TTL expiry.
